business_summary: Palemo Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of specialty stores in Japan. The company sells women's clothing, apparel, and fashion accessories under PALEMO STORE, LUDIC PARK, Re-J&SUPURE, NOÉMIE, Hare no hi / Wood thread clay, illusie300, INCENSE, Bijoux Closet, Lilou de chouchou, FOREST HEART, Recherie, DOSCH, GAL FIT, and SUZUTAN brands. It is also involved in the delivery agency business. The company was formerly known as Palemo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Palemo Holdings Co.,Ltd. in August 2017. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 팔레모홀딩스(주) 일본에서 전문점 체인을 운영하고 있습니다. PALEMO STORE, LUDIC PARK, Re-J&SUPURE, NOÉMIE, Hare no hi/Wood thread clay, illusie300, INCENSE, Bijoux Closet, Lilou de chouchou, FOREST HEART, Recherie, DOSCH, GAL FIT, SUZUTAN 브랜드로 여성 의류, 의류, 패션 액세서리를 판매하고 있습니다. 배송대행사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 회사는 이전에 (주)팔레모로 알려져 있었고, 사명을 팔레모홀딩스(주)로 변경했습니다. 2017년 8월. 이 회사는 1976년에 설립되었으며 일본 나고야에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
